name: fracabu/tassa_soggiorno_app
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed Streamlit app that calculates Rome's imposta di soggiorno (tourist occupancy tax) based on booking details per local regulations. Calculation logic only; no committed historical collections data found.
why_useful: Encodes current Rome tourist-tax rate rules/brackets in code, which could be reused to compute implied tax revenue from Rome nights/ADR estimates, but holds no dataset itself.
themes: Tourist tax and city-tax datasets: Paris taxe de sejour, Amsterdam toeristenbelasting, Italian imposta di soggiorno, Airbnb remittance reports, occupancy-tax remittance by platform
why_all: Encodes current Rome tourist-tax rate rules/brackets in code, which could be reused to compute implied tax revenue from Rome nights/ADR estimates, but holds no dataset itself.

name: Kenneth-Rakentine/30_Night_Occupancy_Tax_Calculator
what_it_holds: Tool that parses uploaded hotel/STR folios to determine 30-night reimbursement eligibility and calculate occupancy-tax reimbursement totals (US, likely North Carolina style long-stay exemption).
why_useful: Marginal utility: a folio-parsing calculator, not a public dataset; only useful as a template if we ever process our own folio-style data.
themes: Tourist tax and city-tax datasets: Paris taxe de sejour, Amsterdam toeristenbelasting, Italian imposta di soggiorno, Airbnb remittance reports, occupancy-tax remittance by platform
why_all: Marginal utility: a folio-parsing calculator, not a public dataset; only useful as a template if we ever process our own folio-style data.

name: Tourism-Indicators-and-Forecasts-
what_it_holds: "Libyan Tourism Indicators and Forecasts: Tourism Economy and Balance of Payments" — appears to be a Central Bank of Libya tourism/BOP indicators page or report mirror; 0 stars, HTML, last updated 27 Sep 2025.
why_useful: A single-country (Libya) tourism balance-of-payments indicator set — Libya is not a material ABNB market, so relevance is marginal, but it is a real, recently-touched repo tying tourism receipts directly to BOP framing, which is the theme's core concept; flagged for completeness rather than expected use.
themes: Payments and merchant data: Visa/Mastercard SpendingPulse releases, Stripe/Adyen indexes, remittance and cross-border card data, tourism receipts from balance of payments

name: scrape (Numbeo cost-of-living scraper)
what_it_holds: Python scraper pulling Numbeo cost-of-living components by country/location. Apache-2.0, 13 stars, updated Apr 2026. No committed CSV output in repo description.
why_useful: A ready scraper skeleton for the sanctioned-if-approved case of building a point-in-time Numbeo cost-of-living panel across ABNB markets (would need a human ToS decision per repo rules before running).
themes: Currency and travel affordability crowdsourced data: Numbeo, Expatistan, hotel price indices (Hotels.com HPI archives), Trivago Hotel Price Index, Kayak price trackers
why_all: A ready scraper skeleton for the sanctioned-if-approved case of building a point-in-time Numbeo cost-of-living panel across ABNB markets (would need a human ToS decision per repo rules before running).
One more maintained Numbeo scraper option if the team wants to build its own point-in-time affordability panel.

name: web-crawling-numbeo
what_it_holds: Scraper that pulls Numbeo cost-of-living data into a PostgreSQL database, dockerized. No data committed, method only. MIT license.
why_useful: Same class as above — a containerized pipeline for building a recurring Numbeo cost-of-living panel if a human authorizes scraping Numbeo.
